name: Mikko Hypponen
biography: Mikko Hypponen is a global security expert who has been working in malware research since 1991. He is currently the Chief Research Officer at WithSecure, a Helsinki-based security company. Mikko has published his research in The New York Times, Wired, and Scientific American. He has lectured at Oxford, Harvard, and MIT. Mr. Hypponen's research team was the first to locate, analyze, and develop protection against the ILOVEYOU email worm - the largest malware outbreak in history. Mikko is also the curator for The Malware Museum at The Internet Archive and for The Museum of Malware Art in Helsinki.
